en-US.releaseNotes:
2026-11-11
Fixed:
- Fetching now also trusts the OS certificate store, so behind a proxy that re-signs HTTPS the requests go through instead of dying on UnknownIssuer
- Requests that come back as a webpage instead of the API now say so, and tell if it is an actual block page or just some random HTML in the way
- Modrinth links will now use /project/<id> instead of /mod/icons for resource packs that aren't mods
- The certificate root package list was updated to drop the eight compromised eMudhra/emSign intermediate CA certificates, so the keys can no longer be used to forge a trusted emSign ECC Root CA - G3 chain
- The resource pack order table now lists the top of the stack first, like the in-game screen does instead of printing the bottom first under a top header, so order no longer looks like it needs upside-down numbers
- add now prefers a resource pack or shader version that lists the exact target Minecraft version, and only falls back to the same minor line when there is nothing exact, so a 1.21.11 build no longer sneaks into a 1.21.1 pack
- verify only warns about a breaks conflict when the installed version is actually inside the declared broken range, so something like newer builds of EMF and ETF stop getting flagged as soft conflicts
- verify no longer dies with The input device is not a TTY when there is no terminal
- test now follows the resource pack order numbers instead of the order the entries sit in packages.json, so it agrees with what build writes
- order with no arguments prints the current order instead of demanding a terminal
- --no-color now also covers the conflict list
- The minimum Rust version to compile is now 1.88
Changed:
- Changelogs will have links to old and new versions in modrinth
